_note: Enemies for the retro side-view battles on the map itself (scripts/stage_battle.gd). art: sprite prefix in assets/explore (<art>_idle, _idle_b, _tell, _wail, _claw, _hurt, _calm, _fade). special: the signature move, telegraphed one enemy turn ahead by its tell; a Hatid prayer landed during the tell cancels it. tip_flag: if the player heard this in the map, the tell says how to beat it. send_home: pray this prayer while the enemy is below this share of its HP to send it home instead of scattering it. portrait: the pixel bust (assets/portraits_px) shown in the special move cut-in.

magbabalot.name: MANG ANDOY
magbabalot.opening: Mang Andoy drifts out from under the balete, his empty basket swinging. He wants you to answer.

claw.name: COLD HAND
claw.text: Grey fingers reach for Teo's throat.

special.name: TAWAG
special.tell: Mang Andoy draws a breath that does not end. His eyes go red. He is about to call Teo's name.
special.text: "TEODORO!" He calls in Lola's voice. Don't answer!
special.interrupted: The prayer drowns out the call! Mang Andoy chokes on Teo's name.
special.dodged: Teo doesn't answer. The call goes past him into the dark.
special.hit: Teo hears Lola and turns to answer. He's spellbound: he'll lose his next turn.

magbabalot.tip: Mang Isko said it: you never answer, you pray. A HATID prayer now will drown out the call.
magbabalot.sent_text: Uwi ka na. Mang Andoy's fare is paid.
magbabalot.victory: Mang Andoy comes apart. Scattered, not sent.
magbabalot.fell_text: Teo falls under the balete. The call goes on.

lunod.name: THE DROWNED
lunod.opening: The water heaves. Hands, then faces: the drowned of every flood this street has ever had.
lunod.victory: The drowned break apart on the sundang and sink back into the brown water. More are rising behind them.

grasp.name: GRASP
grasp.text: Cold hands close on your ankles and pull.

surge.name: SURGE
surge.text: The water rises in a wall of faces and comes down.

chorus.name: CHORUS
chorus.text: Three of them at once, from three sides.

special.name: ANG BAHA
special.tell: The water draws back from the stairs, the way the sea does before a wave.
special.text: A wall of brown water and faces comes down on the parlor!
special.interrupted: Pido's prayer holds the water back. The wave breaks short.
special.hit: The flood knocks Pido off his feet.
special.dodged: Pido gets up the stairs. The wave breaks below him.

lunod.hint: A prayer now will hold the water back.
lunod.fell_text: The water closes over Pido's head.

lunod_rise.name: THE DROWNED, RISING
lunod_rise.opening: Two rise where one sank. The water is at Pido's hips.
lunod_rise.victory: They sink. The water does not. It keeps climbing the stairs, one step at a time.

grasp.name: GRASP
grasp.text: Cold hands close on your ankles and pull.

undertow.name: UNDERTOW
undertow.text: The floor of the parlor slides out from under you. You cannot parry the river. DODGE.

chorus.name: CHORUS
chorus.text: Four of them at once, from four sides.

special.name: ANG BAHA
special.tell: The water draws back from the stairs, the way the sea does before a wave.
special.text: A wall of brown water and faces comes down on the parlor!
special.interrupted: Pido's prayer holds the water back. The wave breaks short.
special.hit: The flood knocks Pido off his feet.
special.dodged: Pido gets up the stairs. The wave breaks below him.

lunod_rise.hint: A prayer now will hold the water back.
lunod_rise.fell_text: The water closes over Pido's head.

lunod_tide.name: THE TIDE OF FACES
lunod_tide.opening: Every flood this street ever had is coming up through the floor at once. There is no end to them. Hold on.
lunod_tide.victory: The water reaches Pido's chest. The sundang is too heavy to lift. There are still more of them.

surge.name: SURGE
surge.text: The water rises in a wall of faces and comes down.

undertow.name: UNDERTOW
undertow.text: The whole room tilts toward the door. You cannot parry the river. DODGE.

chorus.name: CHORUS
chorus.text: Five of them at once. Hands on his arms, his belt, his hair.

special.name: ANG BAHA
special.tell: The whole river leans on the door.
special.text: A wall of brown water and faces comes down on the parlor!
special.interrupted: Pido's prayer holds the water back. The wave breaks short.
special.hit: The flood knocks Pido off his feet.
special.dodged: Pido gets up the stairs. The wave breaks below him.

lunod_tide.fell_text: The water closes over Pido's head.

ligaw_berto.name: MANG BERTO, LIGAW
ligaw_berto.opening: Mang Berto's jaw unhinges. Brown water pours out of it. What is eating him looks at you through his eyes.
ligaw_berto.victory: The hunger tears off him like a wet coat and drains away between the floor tiles.

reach.name: REACH
reach.text: He reaches for you with both hands, too far, too fast.

flood.name: FLOOD
flood.text: River water bursts from his mouth across the tiles. You cannot parry water. DODGE.

grief.name: GRIEF
grief.text: He swings wildly, sobbing, two blows.

special.name: ILOG
special.tell: His cheeks swell. Something gurgles up from very deep inside him.
special.text: River water bursts out of him across the tiles!
special.interrupted: The prayer closes his mouth. He swallows the river back down.
special.hit: The water knocks Teo flat across the tiles.
special.dodged: Teo vaults a chair. The water runs under it.

ligaw_berto.hint: A prayer now will stop it.
ligaw_berto.fell_text: Teo goes down among the folding chairs. The wake goes on without him.

unsent.name: THE CREEK'S UNSENT
unsent.opening: They come up out of the creek all at once, hands first, and the watch is the warmest thing they have felt in years.
unsent.victory: The unsent fall back into the creek and lie still on the bottom, watching. Something bigger is coming, and they know it.

cling.name: CLING
cling.text: Wet hands close on your wrists, your coat, the watch.

undertow.name: UNDERTOW
undertow.text: The whole bank slides toward the water. You cannot parry a creek. DODGE.

swarm.name: SWARM
swarm.text: Four of them at once, from the water and the ladders.

special.name: KAPIT
special.tell: All three turn their heads at once. The water around their feet starts to rise.
special.text: They lunge to hold on to the warmest thing they've felt in years!
special.interrupted: The prayer reaches them first. They let go of the bank.
special.hit: Cold hands close on Teo. He's held fast: he'll lose his next turn.
special.dodged: Teo steps back. Their hands close on air.

unsent.hint: A prayer now will reach them first.
unsent.fell_text: The creek pulls Teo down the bank.

aswang.name: TAGGED ASWANG
aswang.opening: Rusted iron screams overhead. The aswang drops onto the creek bank, and the last streetlight dies.
aswang.victory: The aswang comes apart into thick, oily smoke, and the smoke runs down into the creek.

claw.name: CLAW
claw.text: The Aswang rakes the air, claws low.

lunge.name: LUNGE
lunge.text: The Aswang coils, every rib showing... and LUNGES.

flurry.name: FLURRY
flurry.text: It whirls into a blur of claws. Three strikes, one breath.

drag.name: DRAG UNDER
drag.text: It sweeps low along the waterline to pull you into the creek. You cannot parry the water. DODGE.

special.name: SAKMAL
special.tell: It coils back on its haunches. Every rib shows. It is going to jump.
special.hit: It lands on Teo with its whole weight.

aswang.hint: A heavy blow now will knock it off balance. Or get ready to PARRY.
aswang.fell_text: The aswang drags Teo toward the water.

hiraya_hound.name: HIRAYA HOUND
hiraya_hound.opening: Four piston legs hit the steel table. A round lens glows like a rising sun: a Hiraya hound.
hiraya_hound.victory: The hound's lens cracks. It spits sparks, and its sunrise logo goes dark.

jab.name: JAB
jab.text: The hound's forelegs stab down like pistons.

net.name: NET
net.text: A weighted net spits from its belly. You cannot parry a net. DODGE.

burst.name: BURST
burst.text: Its chassis whines. Three quick shots from the lens.

special.name: SIKAT
special.tell: Its chassis opens. The lens brightens like a sun coming up over the morgue.
special.text: A beam of orange light sweeps the room!
special.interrupted: The current shorts the lens. The sunrise goes out.
special.dodged: They drop behind the steel table. The beam scorches the wall.

hiraya_hound.hint: Kardo: a DISCHARGE now will short it out.
hiraya_hound.fell_text: The hound stands over them, its lens humming.
